name: pradoobd
description: Bespoke web-based OBD2 diagnostic tool for a 2005 Toyota Prado (1KD-FTV diesel), bridging an ELM327 WiFi adapter to a React browser UI.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pradoobd/server && npm run build --workspace @pradoobd/web
